title: JavaScript Arrays: Index 0, Push and Length Explained
description:
Store three skills in a JavaScript array, read the first item with index 0 and learn what push and length do.

Try answering: Which index gives you the first item in an array?

Continue learning: open the JavaScript for Beginners playlist on @Techat60.
Subscribe to TECH AT 60 for practical beginner coding lessons.

Array positions start at zero, so index zero gives the first item.
Push appends an item, and length reports the number of items.

Try it: Create an array of three skills and read its first item.
